Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer prematurely anchored on “Human Origins 101” as the “first National Geographic short” without verification and focused searches around it. This unverified assumption misdirected the investigation away from the correct context (and Monterey Bay Aquarium data), leading to failure to identify the correct #9 and its maximum length (1.8 m) and ultimately contributing to the wrong final answer.
